subject.title: Core hardening tracker: converge duplicated runtime invariants onto single owners

question: After the active run-staleness PR, which verified seam should receive maintainer sponsorship next, and should lower-risk structural rows remain in this umbrella?
rationale: The duplicate paths are source-verifiable, but selecting permanent owners and ordering work across agent, session, provider, and plugin boundaries requires repository architecture judgment.

options.title: Sequence narrow seams
options.body: Keep the umbrella and sponsor one independently reviewed seam at a time, prioritizing observed drift and deleting parallel paths in each PR.

options.title: Limit to proven drift
options.body: Retain only rows with demonstrated behavioral divergence and move type-only or speculative cleanup out of the active program.

options.title: Pause further work
options.body: Keep the merged improvements but defer remaining rows until a concrete regression or owner request supplies stronger urgency.

recommendation.title: Sequence narrow seams
recommendation.body: Keep the umbrella and sponsor one independently reviewed seam at a time, prioritizing observed drift and deleting parallel paths in each PR.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history connects him to representative boundaries, and the remaining choice is cross-cutting repository architecture rather than implementation mechanics.
